events.title: Burgers
events.description: Mondays can be a drag, but not when you can look forward to a delicious $18 burger at Finns!From 5pm every Monday, take your pick from The Finn’s Beef Burger, Fried Chicken Burger, Steak Sandwich and Finn’s Blt!

events.title: AFL Grand Final Day
events.description: The big one’s here. Get yourself to Finn McCools for AFL Grand Final Day and catch every tackle, goal and big moment live and loud across multiple screens.Round up the crew, grab a pint and settle in for a proper afternoon of footy with plenty of good craic around the pub.When the final siren sounds, we’re keeping things rolling with live entertainment ’til late.It’s Grand Final Day. You’ll want a good seat for this one.
